title: Scaling classical hardware for accurate real-time quantum error correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires a classical decoder fast enough to process syndrome measurements at the rate at which they are generated, and to return its decisions with low latency. This is most demanding for superconducting processors, whose fast syndrome cycles force a trade-off between decoding speed and accuracy. Decoders fast enough to keep up sacrifice accuracy, which must be compensated for with larger codes and thus additional physical qubits. Here we introduce Rapids, a streaming neural decoder that is both fast and accurate. We achieve this by co-designing the decoder with a field-programmable gate array (FPGA): the network is built from operations that map cheaply onto the device and trained in its integer arithmetic. translated_title: 扩展经典硬件以实现精确的实时量子纠错
translated_abstract: 容错量子计算需要一个足够快的经典解码器，能够以综合征测量产生的速率对其进行处理，并以低延迟返回决策。这对超导处理器的要求最为苛刻，因为其快速的综合征提取周期迫使解码速度与准确性之间进行权衡。速度足够快以跟上节奏的解码器会牺牲准确性，而准确性的损失必须通过更大的码来补偿，从而需要额外的物理量子比特。本文介绍了Rapids，一种既快速又准确的流式神经解码器。我们通过将解码器与现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）协同设计来实现这一目标：该神经网络由能够低成本映射到硬件上的操作构建，并在其整数算术中进行训练。对于距离为19的表面码，Rapids在单块FPGA上以不到一微秒的时间解码每一轮综合征，对超导处理器而言速度足够快，并以低延迟返回决策。
tldr: 本文提出与FPGA协同设计的流式神经解码器Rapids，在单块FPGA上以亚微秒级延迟对距离-19表面码进行实时解码，同时兼顾速度与精度，满足了超导量子处理器实时量子纠错的苛刻需求。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Rapids, a streaming neural decoder co-designed with an FPGA, which decodes each round of syndromes for the distance-19 surface code in under a microsecond on a single FPGA, achieving both high speed and accuracy for real-time quantum error correction on superconducting processors.
